name: Reputation tokens

subjectOf.text: Meaningful and secure reputation tokens supply the incentives needed for secure proof of stake consensus in block production, which eliminates the unsustainable inefficiencies of proof of work based blockchains.
subjectOf.abstract: giving the proper incentives for guaranteeing secure proof-of- stake consensus protocols for block production. This eliminates the unsustainable inefficiencies of proof-of-work based blockchains.

subjectOf.text: The reputation tokens of the underwriting DAO are separate and distinct from the cash currency that insureds use to pay premia; the two must not be conflated.
subjectOf.abstract: It is important to note that the reputation tokens are separate and distinct from the cash currency that the insured use to pay their premia.

subjectOf.text: Tokens in the proposed DAO function as reputation because an agent's proportional token holdings will grow over time only if that agent follows sound and successful underwriting practices.
subjectOf.abstract: We will refer to these tokens on occasion as reputation tokens as an agent's proportional holdings of these tokens is likely to increase over time only if the agent were to follow sound and successful underwriting practices.

subjectOf.text: The design's innovative features stem from tokens serving several purposes at once: as reward for risk taking and as a substitute for both reputation and capital.

subjectOf.text: Cooperation is sustained only when the promise of future profits outweighs the present value of defecting, so a discount factor that is too low, or a game known to be ending soon, makes defection the rational choice.
subjectOf.abstract: Therefore, the promise of future profits must outweigh the present value to en- sure cooperation.

impatient players or high discounting

subjectOf.text: Anonymity increases rather than decreases the value of reputation tokens, because when potential business partners have less knowledge of a counterparty's identity, the number of reputation tokens held becomes the more important signal.

subjectOf.text: The application that decentralized banking improves most is not currency tokens but reputation tokens, because reputation transactions such as voting and resolving validation pools are generated by every meaningful action.

subjectOf.text: Reputation must be grounded to be meaningful, so reputation tokens should be minted only when policy premia enter the group, reputation should dictate power, and fees should be shared through reputation weighted salaries.

subjectOf.text: Because underwriting mints new reputation tokens, passive holders see their proportional ownership in the DAO fall over time, which is designed to incentivize agents to underwrite actively while still allowing passive investors to earn income.
subjectOf.abstract: Thus, the total number of tokens grows over time. This implies that "passive" agents who hold the tokens purely to receive a share of future premia will find their proportional ownership in the DAO decrease over time.

subjectOf.text: Underwriters encumber reputation tokens against each policy under a preset formula, and if the insured event occurs they lose control of those tokens, which are auctioned to meet the claim, with new tokens minted and sold if the auction falls short.
subjectOf.abstract: In case the insured event were to occur during the life of the policy, the agents who underwrote the policy would lose control of their encumbered tokens, which would be sold at auction to meet the claim.
subjectOf.citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Decentralized Finance (DeFi) (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3782216

subjectOf.text: In the Underwriting DAO a breach occurs only when the market values the encumbered reputation tokens at less than the payout, which requires minting additional tokens to meet the claim.
subjectOf.abstract: We would consider the need to mint more reputation tokens to meet a policy claim to be a breach. Under what circumstances would a breach occur? It would occur only if the market values the encumbered reputation tokens as less than the payout.
subjectOf.citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, Decentralized Finance (DeFi) (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3782216

subjectOf.text: From the viewpoint of consumers and regulators, encumbered reputation tokens serve as a substitute for capital, because they derive their value from the DAO's future cash flows.
subjectOf.abstract: The key point is this: from the viewpoint of consumers and regulators, the encumbered tokens (which as we know derive their value from the DAO's future cash flows) essentially serve as a substitute for capital.
